_comment: Copy this file to config.json in your working directory and edit it. Every path and name the code needs comes through here -- nothing is hardcoded in the modules themselves. Missing or broken config.json falls back to generic built-in defaults.
_comment_cw: To ingest Claude Code transcripts (~/.claude/projects/<project-key>/<session>.jsonl) instead of a flat directory of plain logs, set: raw_log_dir=~/.claude/projects, ingest_format=claude_code, raw_log_recursive=true, cw_units_dir=~/claude-workspaces/units
